meta.note: Light-mode system after the reference UI Mohammad sent on 2026-10-22: peach glow ground, white rounded cards, orange active state, black sheet for the route. Dark panel colours are tokens of the light theme, not a second theme.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. Warm near-white; the blush glow sits on top of it.

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: Centre of the radial glow at the top of home and result screens (radial-gradient blush → blush-soft → transparent). Never a flat fill.

tokens.name: blush-soft
tokens.usage: Outer ring of the glow; also the map ground tint.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, chips, the composer. Radius-lg, soft orange shadow (shadow-card), no border.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Icon circles inside white cards; the glass circles in the top bar at 55% alpha.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and headings on paper and surface. 15.6:1 on paper.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, dates, units, hints. 5.7:1 on paper, 4.6:1 on blush.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Rare hairlines (table rows in admin). Cards do not use borders.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: The brand colour and the active state: selected chip, active shop card, current route stop, primary button, bars and rings. Text on it is on-orange.

tokens.name: orange-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed state of orange; gradient end for the avatar.

tokens.name: orange-tint
tokens.usage: Inactive bars, icon circle behind an orange icon, selected row background in admin.

tokens.name: on-orange
tokens.usage: Text and icons on orange. 3.1:1, so only at 15px bold or larger; captions on orange stay off.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: The black sheet (route, in-shop mode), status pills on cards («در حال جست‌وجو»), the composer bar. Text on it is on-dark.

tokens.name: panel-2
tokens.usage: Inactive segments and chips inside the panel.

tokens.name: panel-brown
tokens.usage: First stat card inside the panel (price).

tokens.name: panel-plum
tokens.usage: Second stat card inside the panel (verification). Only ever inside the panel.

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Text and icons on panel, panel-brown and panel-plum.

tokens.name: verified
tokens.usage: Only the verified state (team check, price newer than 60 days): pill, small caption, check icon.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Warnings with a word next to them: reported closed, price far above market, unverified claim.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px outside the control; blue so it never reads as a brand state.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The screen headline. Thin weight with ONE bold phrase inside («کجا برم؟» at 800), the way the reference mixes regular and italic. Persian has no italic, so weight contrast does that job.

styles.name: display-bold
styles.usage: The bold phrase inside display. Never a whole headline in 800.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Card headline, same thin + bold mix as display.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The big number on the black sheet and in stat cards: unit, minutes, price. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Price inside a white card; the unit («تومان · میانه») follows at body weight in ink-muted.

styles.name: price-compact
styles.usage: Price in a list row, thousands of toman, unit implied by the list header.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Nav bar title, shop name in a row.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: سه مغازه تو همین پاساژ ارزون‌تر دارن.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: ۱۲ مغازه در این پاساژ · ۳ تا زیر میانه
styles.usage: Meta line under a number, in ink-muted.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Status under a price in a row: verified green, signal red.

styles.name: receipt
styles.usage: Record ids in the receipt drawer, team only.

spacing.note: 4px base. 20px gutters on phones (the reference breathes more than 16).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips; between bars.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between stat cards; inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between cards; sheet gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page gutter; card inner padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Sheet bottom padding; between sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top of screen content under the status bar.

radius.note: Big and soft everywhere, like the reference. Nothing is square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons inside cards, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Chips, stat cards in the panel, small cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Content cards and shop rows.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of the black sheet.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, segments, icon circles, the composer.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Every white card. Orange-tinted so it reads warm, not grey.

tokens.name: shadow-pin
tokens.usage: The active map pin only.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: The black sheet over the map.
